guidebook.intro: Call for help, deal with accidents and report a theft. **Gi-** often turns a sentence into “someone did it”.

tips.title: Konya!
body: **Konya!** (help me!) is **kony** (help) with **-a** (me). **Oyot!** (quickly!) and **Go cim bot polic!** (call the police!) get things moving.

tips.title: Gikwalo cim mera
body: Acholi often says “they did it” where English says “it was done”: **Gikwalo cim mera** (they stole my phone: my phone has been stolen).

culture.title: Neighbours first
body: In an emergency, neighbours come first: a shout of **Konya!** brings people running long before help arrives from town.
